goal: Renew the exact outcome-blind intake monitor after its normal 145-poll completion without changing the scientific intake contract or selecting an archive.
allowed_change: Invoke the installed exact monitor in --initialize mode once, creating a new PID and appending a new poll cycle to the existing append-only log.
forbidden_changes: changing archive order or choosing an archive
changing intake, scorer, registry, stability, or security configuration
reading archive payload identities beyond existing credential-first structural intake
reading labels, outcomes, predictions, accuracy, utility, candidate profile, or private selection
starting GPU, paid API, model fit, or base-model update
overwriting the previous log or completion evidence
